en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" MSV,
Strike Rouge + I.W.S.P. with combined seal is now available in RG & HG specifications!
“Let's have fun by combining RG series items and HG series items!!”
●● Comes with a newly designed 'realistic decal' that has a sense of unity with RG!
The molding color of HG I.W.S.P. has also been changed to match the image of the RG body! ! ●●
*In the realistic decal of "RG Strike Rouge (exclusive) + HG I.W.S.P." that is newly included with this product,
No foil is used.
*The marking design and molding color of the RG Strike Rouge body remain unchanged.
RG 1/144 Strike Rouge
H.G.I.W.S.P.
- Comes with a newly designed realistic decal for I.W.S.P. (*There is no marking using foil.)
In addition to the above markings, a realistic decal for the strike (using foil) is included.
- Includes a new wrist part (right hand) that allows the beam rifle to be posed stably.
- Includes connection parts to join RG main body and HG I.W.S.P.
Attached weapons: 115mm railgun/9.1m anti-ship sword/combined seal/beam boomerang/Gatling gun/beam rifle
*RG Ale Striker is not included.
●HG I.W.S.P. can also be joined to RG Strike Gundam (sold separately)!
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE/ABS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
